# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data Si.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

# Define variables

variable Tend equal 2500.0
variable Tdamp equal 100.0
variable Pdamp equal 1000.0
variable rate equal 2.2

# Run heating
run $(v_Tend-v_Tstart)/v_rate

# Equilibrate at 2500K
fix 2 all npt temp ${Tend} ${Tend} ${Tdamp} iso 0.0 0.0 ${Pdamp}
run 500000  # 500 ps with timestep of 1 fs

thermo_style custom step temp press density
